description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the Goteo Application's Lang class, testing language selection, retrieval, and settings functionality.

classes.name: LangTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the Lang class, verifying language management functionalities.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of the Lang class and asserts it is an instance of \\Goteo\\Application\\Lang.

methods.name: testList
methods.description: Verifies that Lang::listAll returns arrays and captures the full language list without parameters.

methods.name: testShortFunctions
methods.description: Checks setting and retrieving the default language, current language, language activation status, and properties like locale and name.

methods.name: testSetters
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of language properties like short, locale, name, and object, and switches languages to ensure correctness.
